pr_title: fix: a human-readable error when lock cannot be acquired

issue_context.title: Why does the compilation fail during installation
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: latest
- Operating System: big sur
- Node.js version: 16.7.0
- Browser: none
- Extra: none

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/60562136/132089717-4414f2ae-ad9d-462a-9180-8e43743b093e.png)

As shown, I'm tried to install playwright. But this throws an error. Why?
comments: We should suggest removing the ms-playwright folder from under ~/Library/Caches when this happens instead of failing.

@368573607 a few questions:
- did you launch installation a few times and aborted it?
- can you try running - does it download archive for you?
    ```sh
    $ curl -o chromium.zip https://playwright.azureedge.net/builds/chromium/901522/chromium-linux.zip
    ```

review_comments: ~~has to be in parenthesis since the first `if` clause is multi-line.~~
ah, i'd rather have it this way i guess!
just in case we have a lockfile actually inside the lock directory at some future point of time ( this is a common practice in some unix systems)
